title: 第23章 大成求追读求收藏求月票推荐票第24章 攻寨求追读求收藏求月票推荐票
content_zh:
“成了！”
苏牧平静地回到自己租赁的小院，关好院门之后，脸上才露出了如释重负的笑容。
房间内探出半个身子，不是杨锦又是何人？
“呼！”
杨锦也是长长松了口气，“如此，在出城之前，邢兆福必定不敢再针对你了。
不过等到攻打黑龙寨的时候，他必定会想尽办法让你死在城外。”
“攻打黑龙寨的时间定在一个月之后。”
苏牧说道，“邢兆福需要重新招募人手，一个月之后出城剿匪。”
一个月时间，苏牧忍不住叹了口气。
一个月时间终究还是太短了一些，就算他现在的身份和职业每天至少能得到10点点数，一个月也才三百点而已。
最多只能将伏波刀法练到大成。
听起来很不错，但肯定不是淬体二境的邢兆福的对手。
可惜，他刚刚试图通过司马何玉兴免去出城剿匪的差事，结果被何玉兴直接拒绝了。
何玉兴还给他画了一张大饼，许诺如果他能在攻打黑龙寨的时候立下功劳，那就提拔他当捕头。
这等话苏牧只当他是在放屁。
“杨锦，你以前在军中的时候难道没有学过淬体法？”
苏牧沉吟着问道。
“学过。”
杨锦沉默了片刻，缓缓地道，“但我资质不行，连淬体一境都没有练成。
这个淬体法我不能教你。”

“规矩？”
“军中功法不能外传。”
杨锦点点头，说道，“而且军中淬体法有些霸道，对身体损害极大，如果不是实在没有办法，我并不建议你修炼军中的淬体法。”
…………
自从击杀粉红狼杜迁之后，苏牧的日子就恢复了以往的平静。
邢兆福忙着筹备人马，或许也有司马何玉兴的威慑，总之他没有找苏牧的麻烦。
杨锦也不知道在忙活什么，自从那日之后就不见了人影。
苏牧也乐得平静，他每日低调的点卯、巡街，尽职尽责地履行着属于捕快的责任。
眨眼时间，已经过去了二十日时间。
苏牧盘膝坐在房间内，眼睛炯炯有神。
子时一过，面板上的内容悄然变化。
content_en:
"It's done!"
Su Mu calmly returned to the small courtyard he rented, and after closing the door, a relieved smile appeared on his face.
Half of the body was leaning out of the room. Who was it if it wasn't Yang Jin?
"Phew!"
Yang Jin also breathed a long sigh of relief, "In this case, Xing Zhaofu will not dare to target you again before leaving the city.
But when he attacks Black Dragon Village, he will definitely try his best to make you die outside the city. "
"The time to attack Black Dragon Village is set in one month."
Su Mu said, "Xing Zhaofu needs to recruit new people and leave the city to suppress the bandits in a month."
After a month, Su Mu couldn't help but sigh.
After all, one month is still too short. Even if he can get at least 10 points every day with his current status and occupation, it is only 300 points a month.
At most, one can only practice the Fubo Sword Technique to perfection.
It sounds good, but it is definitely no match for Xing Zhaofu in the second realm of Body Tempering.
Unfortunately, he had just tried to use Sima He Yuxing to avoid going out of the city to suppress bandits, but was directly rejected by He Yuxing.
He Yuxing also drew a big pie for him, promising that if he could make a contribution during the attack on Heilong Village, he would be promoted to head catcher.
Su Mu just thought he was farting.
"Yang Jin, didn't you learn the body tempering method when you were in the army?"
Su Mu asked thoughtfully.
"Learned."
Yang Jin was silent for a moment and said slowly, "But my qualifications are not good and I haven't even mastered the body tempering realm.
I can't teach you this body tempering method. "
"Rules?"
"The martial arts in the military cannot be passed on to outsiders."
Yang Jin nodded and said, "Moreover, the body-tempering methods in the military are a bit overbearing and extremely harmful to the body. If you don't really have no other choice, I don't recommend you practice the body-tempering methods in the military."
…………
Since killing the pink wolf Du Qian, Su Mu's life has returned to its previous calm.
Xing Zhaofu was busy preparing troops, and perhaps he was intimidated by Sima He Yuxing, but in short he did not cause trouble for Su Mu.
Yang Jin didn't know what he was busy with, and he had disappeared since that day.
Su Mu was also happy and calm. He kept a low profile every day and patrolled the streets, fulfilling his duties as a police officer conscientiously.
In the blink of an eye, twenty days have passed.
Su Mu sat cross-legged in the room, his eyes bright.
After a while, the content on the panel quietly changed.
